title: Sensational Soccer

controls.action: Move the selected player; steer the ball with aftertouch after a shot
Shoot with the ball; slide tackle without it; confirm in menus
Pass with the ball; switch to the player nearest the ball without it; back in menus

credits: Built for the PRG32 RISC-V educational console
Original code, procedural graphics, pixel sprites, font, music, and synthesized sound effects
Classic home-computer football readability was a genre reference; no third-party code, art, names, or assets were used
